remarks: OYes, you read that right. This spacious townhouse has not one, not two, not three, but FOUR bathrooms (two full and two half). It truly lives like a single-family home, spanning three full levels and featuring a rare upper-level loft-perfect as a third bedroom, private home office, or cozy bonus room-complete with its own heating, A/C, and en-suite bathroom. The main level offers a great flow between the kitchen, dining area, and living room, all accented by beautiful hardwood floors, a wood-burning fireplace, sliding glass doors leading to the private deck, a convenient half bath, a dedicated laundry room, and an abundance of closet space throughout. The second level has two generously sized bedrooms, including a primary suite with its own private full bath. A hall half bath serves the second bedroom and guests. The home is move-in ready with fresh neutral paint, updated bathroom vanities, and brand-new kitchen appliances (microwave, dishwasher, and refrigerator). The hot water tank was replaced in June 2025 for added peace of mind. Storage is exceptional, with an abundance of closets including attic space and a storage unit. Location is a major win- only about 5 minutes to the train station for a smooth commute, and roughly 10 minutes to charming New Canaan and Darien. Think that classic, welcoming Connecticut community feel. This place checks every practical box while delivering that special, hard-to-find vibe. Sunday 3/15 Open house canceled. Accepted offer
